## QC on Reads
```{bash, eval=FALSE}
conda activate sequali-env
sequali --outdir outputs/Z_pseudo/sequali data/Z_pseudo/zygosaccharomycesPseudorouxii.fastq

sequali --outdir outputs/Z_pseudo/sequali data/Z_pseudo/zygosaccharomycesPseudorouxii2026.fastq

sequali --outdir outputs/L_thermo/sequali data/L_thermo/lachanceaThermotolerans.fastq

sequali --outdir outputs/L_thermo/sequali data/L_thermo/lachanceaThermotolerans2026.fastq

sequali --outdir outputs/T_del/sequali data/T_del/torulasporaDelbrueckii.fastq

sequali --outdir outputs/T_del/sequali data/T_del/torulasporaDelbrueckii2026.fastq
```

## Put them together
```{bash, eval=FALSE}
cat data/Z_pseudo/zygosaccharomycesPseudorouxii2026.fastq data/Z_pseudo/zygosaccharomycesPseudorouxii.fastq > data/Z_pseudo/Z_pseudo.fastq

cat data/L_thermo/lachanceaThermotolerans2026.fastq data/L_thermo/lachanceaThermotolerans.fastq > data/L_thermo/L_thermo.fastq

cat data/T_del/torulasporaDelbrueckii2026.fastq data/T_del/torulasporaDelbrueckii.fastq > data/T_del/T_del.fastq
```

## Filtering
```{bash, eval=FALSE}
filtlong data/Z_pseudo/Z_pseudo.fastq --keep_percent 80 --min_mean_q 90 > outputs/Z_pseudo/Z_pseudo_filt.fastq

filtlong data/L_thermo/L_thermo.fastq --keep_percent 80 --min_mean_q 90 > outputs/L_thermo/L_thermo_filt.fastq

filtlong data/T_del/T_del.fastq --keep_percent 80 --min_length 100 --min_mean_q 90 > outputs/T_del/T_del_filt.fastq
```

## QC Post-Filtering
```{bash, eval=FALSE}
sequali --outdir outputs/Z_pseudo/sequali outputs/Z_pseudo/Z_pseudo_filt.fastq

sequali --outdir outputs/L_thermo/sequali outputs/L_thermo/L_thermo_filt.fastq

sequali --outdir outputs/T_del/sequali outputs/T_del/T_del_filt.fastq
conda deactivate
```

## Assembly
```{bash, eval=FALSE}
conda activate flye-env
flye --nano-raw outputs/Z_pseudo/Z_pseudo_filt.fastq --out-dir outputs/Z_pseudo/flye --threads 8 --genome-size 10m

flye --nano-raw outputs/L_thermo/L_thermo_filt.fastq --out-dir outputs/L_thermo/flye --threads 8 --genome-size 10m

flye --nano-raw outputs/T_del/T_del_filt.fastq --out-dir outputs/T_del/flye --threads 8 --genome-size 9m
conda deactivate
```

## Assembly Statistics
```{r, message=FALSE}
library(stringr)
Z_log <- readLines("outputs/Z_pseudo/flye/flye.log")
start <- grep("Assembly statistics:", Z_log)
Z <- Z_log[(start+2):(start+7)]
Z <- str_replace_all(Z, "\t", "")
Z <- strsplit(Z, ":")
Z_df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, Z))
print("Z. pseudorouxii Assembly Stats")
print(Z_df)

cat("\n")
L_log <- readLines("outputs/L_thermo/flye/flye.log")
start <- grep("Assembly statistics:", L_log)
L <- L_log[(start+2):(start+7)]
L <- str_replace_all(L, "\t", "")
L <- strsplit(L, ":")
L_df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, L))
print("L. thermotolerans Assembly Stats")
print(L_df)

cat("\n")
T_log <- readLines("outputs/T_del/flye/flye.log")
start <- grep("Assembly statistics:", T_log)
Td <- T_log[(start+2):(start+7)]
Td <- str_replace_all(Td, "\t", "")
Td <- strsplit(Td, ":")
T_df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, Td))
print("T. delbrueckii Assembly Stats")
print(T_df)
```

Dropping T. delbrueckii because it's so bad

## Annotation


```{bash, eval=FALSE}
IMAGE="nextgenusfs/funannotate:v1.8.15"
PLATFORM="--platform linux/amd64"
CPUS=8
INPUT="outputs/Z_pseudo/medaka/consensus.fasta"
OUT="outputs/Z_pseudo/funannotate"
SPECIES="Zygosaccharomyces pseudorouxii"
STRAIN="MRK2"
PROTEIN_EVIDENCE="data/Z_pseudo/proteins.faa"
RNA="data/Z_pseudo/rna.fna"


docker run -u $(id -u):$(id -g) --rm -v "$PWD":/data -w /data $PLATFORM $IMAGE \
  funannotate clean \
  -i $INPUT \
  -o ${OUT}/assembly_clean.fasta
  
  
docker run -u $(id -u):$(id -g) --rm -v "$PWD":/data -w /data $PLATFORM $IMAGE \
  funannotate sort \
  -i ${OUT}/assembly_clean.fasta \
  -o ${OUT}/assembly_sorted.fasta
  
  
docker run -u $(id -u):$(id -g) --rm -v "$PWD":/data -w /data $PLATFORM $IMAGE \
  funannotate mask \
  -i ${OUT}/assembly_sorted.fasta \
  -o ${OUT}/assembly_masked.fasta \
  --cpus $CPUS
  
  
  
docker run -u $(id -u):$(id -g) --rm -v "$PWD":/data -w /data $PLATFORM $IMAGE \
  funannotate predict \
  -i ${OUT}/assembly_masked.fasta \
  -o $OUT \
  -s "$SPECIES" \
  --strain "$STRAIN" \
  --busco_db dikarya \
  --protein_evidence "$PROTEIN_EVIDENCE" \
  --transcript_evidence "$RNA" \
  --cpus $CPUS

```

## Functional Annotation with eggNOG
```{bash, eval=FALSE}
conda activate eggnog_env

EGGNOG_DB_PATH="data/eggnog_db"

emapper.py \
  -i outputs/Z_pseudo/funannotate/predict_results/*.proteins.fa \
  --output functional \
  --output_dir outputs/Z_pseudo/eggnog \
  --data_dir $EGGNOG_DB_PATH \
  --decorate_gff yes \
  --excel \
  -m diamond \
  --cpu 8
  
  
emapper.py \
  -i outputs/L_thermo/funannotate/predict_results/*.proteins.fa \
  --output functional \
  --output_dir outputs/L_thermo/eggnog \
  --data_dir $EGGNOG_DB_PATH \
  --decorate_gff yes \
  --excel \
  -m diamond \
  --cpu 8
  
  
emapper.py \
  -i data/S_cerevisiae_proteins.faa \
  --output functional \
  --output_dir outputs/S_cerev \
  --data_dir $EGGNOG_DB_PATH \
  --decorate_gff yes \
  --excel \
  -m diamond \
  --cpu 8
  
```


```{r, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(GO.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)

target_GOs <- c("GO:0006970", "GO:0006972", "GO:0071470", "GO:0106049", "GO:0032872", "GO:0000196", "GO:0005991", "GO:0090062")

L_eggnog <- read_tsv("outputs/L_thermo/eggnog/functional.emapper.annotations", comment = "##", show_col_types = FALSE)

go_long <- L_eggnog %>%
  filter(GOs != "-" & !is.na(GOs)) %>%
  separate_rows(GOs, sep = ",")

hits <- go_long[go_long$GOs %in% target_GOs, ]
L_go_counts <- table(factor(hits$GOs, levels = target_GOs))
L_go_count_df <- data.frame(GO = names(L_go_counts), count = as.integer(L_go_counts))
L_go_count_df$GO_name <- Term(L_go_count_df$GO)
print("L. thermotolerans")
print(L_go_count_df)
print(paste("Total: ", sum(L_go_count_df$count)))



Z_eggnog <- read_tsv("outputs/Z_pseudo/eggnog/functional.emapper.annotations", comment = "##", show_col_types = FALSE)

go_long <- Z_eggnog %>%
  filter(GOs != "-" & !is.na(GOs)) %>%
  separate_rows(GOs, sep = ",")

hits <- go_long[go_long$GOs %in% target_GOs, ]
Z_go_counts <- table(factor(hits$GOs, levels = target_GOs))
Z_go_count_df <- data.frame(GO = names(Z_go_counts), count = as.integer(Z_go_counts))
Z_go_count_df$GO_name <- Term(Z_go_count_df$GO)
cat("\n")
print("Z. pseudorouxii")
print(Z_go_count_df)
print(paste("Total: ", sum(Z_go_count_df$count)))



S_eggnog <- read_tsv("outputs/S_cerev/functional.emapper.annotations", comment = "##", show_col_types = FALSE)

go_long <- S_eggnog %>%
  filter(GOs != "-" & !is.na(GOs)) %>%
  separate_rows(GOs, sep = ",")

hits <- go_long[go_long$GOs %in% target_GOs, ]
S_go_counts <- table(factor(hits$GOs, levels = target_GOs))
S_go_count_df <- data.frame(GO = names(S_go_counts), count = as.integer(S_go_counts))
S_go_count_df$GO_name <- Term(S_go_count_df$GO)
cat("\n")
print("S. cerevisiae")
print(S_go_count_df)
print(paste("Total: ", sum(S_go_count_df$count)))
```


```{r}
library(KEGGREST)



target_keggs <- c("ko:K11231", "ko:K11232", "ko:K11233", "ko:K11230", "ko:K11246", "ko:K19849", "ko:K19848", "ko:K19850", "ko:K04393", "ko:K04409", "ko:K19833", "ko:K19841", "ko:K11228", "ko:K11227", "ko:K04441", "ko:K19806", "ko:K19704", "ko:K19815", "ko:K19807", "ko:K09468", "ko:K09051", "ko:K00006", "ko:K03781", "ko:K17741")

ko_lib <- keggList(target_keggs)
ko_lib <- sub("\\s*\\[EC:[^]]*\\]", "", ko_lib)


kegg_long <- L_eggnog %>%
  filter(KEGG_ko != "-" & !is.na(KEGG_ko)) %>%
  separate_rows(KEGG_ko, sep = ",")

hits <- kegg_long[kegg_long$KEGG_ko %in% target_keggs, ]
L_ko_counts <- table(factor(hits$KEGG_ko, levels = target_keggs))
L_ko_count_df <- data.frame(KEGG = names(L_ko_counts), count = as.integer(L_ko_counts))
ko_ids <- sub("^ko:", "", L_ko_count_df$KEGG)
L_ko_count_df$KO_name <- unname(ko_lib[ko_ids])
print("L. thermotolerans")
print(L_ko_count_df)
print(paste("Total: ", sum(L_ko_count_df$count)))


kegg_long <- Z_eggnog %>%
  filter(KEGG_ko != "-" & !is.na(KEGG_ko)) %>%
  separate_rows(KEGG_ko, sep = ",")

hits <- kegg_long[kegg_long$KEGG_ko %in% target_keggs, ]
Z_ko_counts <- table(factor(hits$KEGG_ko, levels = target_keggs))
Z_ko_count_df <- data.frame(KEGG = names(Z_ko_counts), count = as.integer(Z_ko_counts))
ko_ids <- sub("^ko:", "", Z_ko_count_df$KEGG)
Z_ko_count_df$KO_name <- unname(ko_lib[ko_ids])
cat("\n")
print("Z. pseudorouxii")
print(Z_ko_count_df)
print(paste("Total: ", sum(Z_ko_count_df$count)))


kegg_long <- S_eggnog %>%
  filter(KEGG_ko != "-" & !is.na(KEGG_ko)) %>%
  separate_rows(KEGG_ko, sep = ",")

hits <- kegg_long[kegg_long$KEGG_ko %in% target_keggs, ]
S_ko_counts <- table(factor(hits$KEGG_ko, levels = target_keggs))
```

## Plots
```{r}
GO_totals <- data.frame(Species = c("Z. pseudorouxii", "L. thermotolerans", "S. cerevisiae"),
                   gene_counts = c(194, 210, 308))
library(ggplot2)

library(forcats)

plot <- ggplot(data, aes(x = fct_inorder(Species), y = gene_counts, fill = fct_inorder(Species))) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Z. pseudorouxii" = "orange", "L. thermotolerans" = "purple", "S. cerevisiae" = "green3")) +
  labs(x = "Species", y = "Gene Count") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())
plot
```
